description: Enhanced Git diff navigation: seamlessly jump between changes across multiple files, review loop detection, smart notifications. Press F7/Shift+F7 to navigate changes without single-file loops
command.previousChange.title: Go to Previous Change (Enhanced)
command.nextChange.title: Go to Next Change (Enhanced)
configuration.title: Git Enhance
configuration.enabled.description: Enable/disable cross-file navigation feature. When disabled, restores original VS Code behavior
configuration.enableLoopAcrossAllFiles.d: Enable looping from last file to first file
configuration.maxOpenEditors.description: Maximum number of editors to keep open during cross-file navigation
configuration.enableReviewLoop.descripti: Enable review loop detection. When enabled, the extension will notify you when you've completed a full review cycle and returned to a previously reviewed file
configuration.notificationMode.descripti: Control when to show boundary notifications (reached first/last change). Smart mode shows for first 3 times per VS Code session, then auto-hides
configuration.notificationMode.smart: Smart: Show notifications for the first 3 times per VS Code session, then automatically hide. Counter resets when VS Code restarts
configuration.notificationMode.always: Always: Always show notifications at boundaries
